risks.title: Restrictions on assignment and subletting
risks.citation_snippet: Lessee shall not voluntarily or by operation of law assign, transfer, mortgage or encumber... or sublet all or any part of Lessee's interest in this Lease or in the Premises without Lessor's prior written consent.

risks.title: No general early termination right for Lessee
risks.citation_snippet: Nine (9) years and Three (3) months ("Original Term") commencing March 1, 2023 ("Commencement Date") and ending May 31, 2032 ("Expiration Date")

risks.title: Net lease structure - Lessee bears most operating costs
risks.citation_snippet: This Lease is a "Net" lease and, except as expressly provided to the contrary in this Lease, Lessee is responsible for paying all amounts due in connection with use of the Premises.

risks.title: Holdover rent penalty at 150%
risks.citation_snippet: In the event that Lessee holds over, then the Base Rent shall be increased to 150% of the Base Rent applicable immediately preceding the expiration or termination.

risks.title: Missing force majeure clause
risks.citation_snippet: N/A - no force majeure clause found in document

renewal_options.value: Two (2) five (5) year options to extend at then fair-market lease rate (not less than prior Base Rent), with subsequent annual increases at market rate but not less than 3.5%. Lessee must provide written notice no earlier than 12 months and no later than 6 months prior to the then-current lease termination date. Options are personal to original Lessee (and Permitted Transferees). Subject to Paragraph 39 provisions including no exercise during Default.
renewal_options.source_text: Lessee shall have two (2) five (5) year options to extend the lease term (each an "Option") at the then fair-market lease rate at the time an Option is exercised; however, the starting Base Rent for any Option(s) term(s), if and when exercised, shall not be less than the previous Base Rent prior to the start of any Option term.

property_address.source_text: commonly known as (street address, city, state, zip): 3 Latitude Way, Corona, CA, 92881 ("Premises")

escalation_clauses.value: Base Rent increases per fixed rent schedule in Paragraph 52 during the initial 9-year 3-month term. Annual increases range from approximately 3.3% to 4.3%. For option periods, rent resets to fair market value (not less than prior Base Rent), then increases by the then-current market increase but not less than 3.5% annually.
escalation_clauses.source_text: the starting Base Rent for any Option(s) term(s), if and when exercised, shall not be less than the previous Base Rent prior to the start of any Option term. Thereafter, the Base Rent shall be increased by the then current market increase, but in no event less than three and one-half (3.5%) percent.

base_rent_frequency.source_text: $69,491.15 per month ("Base Rent"), payable on the first day of each month

termination_clauses.value: No general early termination or break clause for Lessee. Lease may be terminated under limited circumstances: (1) Capital Expenditure exceeding 6 months' Base Rent in last 2 years of Lease (Paragraph 2.3(a)); (2) Lessor may terminate for uninsured partial damage (Paragraph 9.3); (3) Total destruction terminates lease after 60 days (Paragraph 9.4); (4) Hazardous Substance Condition with remediation cost exceeding 12x monthly Base Rent or $100,000 (Paragraph 6.2(g)); (5) Condemnation (Paragraph 14); (6) Damage near end of term exceeding one month's Base Rent (Paragraph 9.5); (7) Failure to deliver possession within 120 days (Paragraph 3.3).
termination_clauses.source_text: Multiple termination provisions across Paragraphs 2.3, 3.3, 6.2(g), 9.3, 9.4, 9.5, and 14

current_monthly_rent.source_text: $69,491.15 per month ("Base Rent"), payable on the first day of each month commencing March 1, 2023

rent_escalation_type.value: Fixed step increases per rent schedule during initial term; Market Rental Value adjustment for renewal options with minimum 3.5% annual increases
